outbound-pool.writes: Only prefixed new sources/pools/manual outbounds, pre-registered fixed public-catalog candidates, and routes targeting two registered acceptance grants. Full order/refresh only with empty baseline collections. No original resources/users/grants modified. May restart only migate-gate; original services/listeners verified.
outbound-pool.cleanup: Wait terminal, disarm owned auto pools, wait terminal again; remove owned routes then pools/manual outbounds/sources and registered Gate fixture; compare exact baseline. Unregistered candidates or unknown results block subsequent runs.

guestbook.writes: Only newly created public pages bearing the per-run fixture prefix. No users, grants, Gate configuration or existing page edits.
guestbook.cleanup: Delete owned pages (including their guestbook data); verify the full pre-existing page baseline. Unexpected changes block later production runs.
